title: Transfusion in Gastrointestinal Bleeding
brief_summary: Aim: To evaluate the feasibility and safety of a restrictive versus liberal red blood cell (RBC) transfusion policy in adult patients admitted with Acute Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding (AUGIB) in order to inform the design of a definitive phase III randomised controlled trial.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 18 or over years presenting with AUGIB, defined by haematemesis or melaena.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with whom the responsible clinician considers there is a need for immediate RBC transfusion prior to obtaining or regardless of the initial Hb result due to severity of bleeding.
* Existing hospital in-patients who develop AUGIB.
